Package org.checkerframework.framework.stubifier

package org.checkerframework.framework.stubifier
  • Class
    Description
    BinaryStubFileGenerator
    Build-time generator that pre-parses .astub files into the binary stub format read by org.checkerframework.framework.stub.BinaryStubReader.
    BinaryStubFileGeneratorTest
    Tests for BinaryStubFileGenerator's two modes (per-file siblings, and a whole-directory --bundle), and for the source-fingerprint staleness detection that BinaryStubData.matchesSource(byte[]) provides for a user-supplied -Astubs file (see AnnotationFileElementTypes#commandLineBinaryStub, which relies on it instead of comparing file modification times).
    BinaryStubWriter
    Writes parsed stub compilation units into the compressed binary stub format read by org.checkerframework.framework.stub.BinaryStubReader.
    BinaryStubWriterTest
    Tests for BinaryStubWriter.
    BinaryStubWriterTest.Enclosing
    Encloses BinaryStubWriterTest.Enclosing.DoublyNested, whose binary name has two $ separators.
    BinaryStubWriterTest.Enclosing.DoublyNested
    An annotation two levels deep, to exercise more than one nesting separator.
    JavaStubifier
    Rewrites Java source files, in place, into minimal stub files, and also generates the compressed binary stub file (BinaryStubWriter.OUTPUT_FILENAME) for the same directory from the same parsed compilation units.
    JavaStubifierTest
    Regression test for a bug where JavaStubifier's BinaryStubWriter was held in a private static final field: since main can process several directories in one invocation, and a BinaryStubWriter accumulates every class passed to process in instance fields with no reset between calls, reusing one writer across directories made each directory's own annotated-jdk.bin.gz also contain every earlier directory's classes.
